ontology.note: Pack namespace only; mints no host term.

implementation.definition: implemented in the host; see supersededBy

changes.description: Assigns each point to a projection site and records the straight-line distance, which is part of the result rather than a detail: a projection at a site is not a value for an arbitrary point.

evidence.note: No implementation exists in this pack and none is intended. The contract is implemented in the host, whose own release carries its evidence. Distance would use the host haversine calculation; nearest-site assignment is not a statement that the projection applies at the point.

supersededBy.reason: A pack that ships no executable code is a specification; the host implements it. Retired here so no node type has two definitions.
supersededBy.deviation: Three inputs rather than two. A table has no geometry in the host (fw:DataTable is disjoint from fw:PointDataset), so the published sites arrive as a point layer rather than inside the projections table. The output is a table of distances, so the join can be displayed.
